Allocate LE Audio group.

NULL -- Allocate LE Audio group failed.

返回:

LE Audio group handle: T_BLE_AUDIO_GROUP_HANDLE.

bool ble_audio_group_reg_cb(T_BLE_AUDIO_GROUP_HANDLE group_handle, P_FUN_AUDIO_GROUP_CB p_fun_cb)

Register LE Audio group callback function.

bap_audio_group.h

参数:

  • group_handle -- [in] Audio group handle: T_BLE_AUDIO_GROUP_HANDLE.

  • p_fun_cb -- [in] Audio group callback function: P_FUN_AUDIO_GROUP_CB.

返回值:

  • true -- Registering LE Audio group callback function is successful.

  • false -- Registering LE Audio group callback function failed.

返回:

The result of registering LE Audio group callback function.

bool ble_audio_group_release(T_BLE_AUDIO_GROUP_HANDLE *p_group_handle)

Release LE Audio group.

bap_audio_group.h

If this API is successfully invoked, the referred group handle will be cleared.

参数:

p_group_handle -- [in] Pointer to audio group handle: T_BLE_AUDIO_GROUP_HANDLE.

返回值:

  • true -- Releasing LE Audio group is successful.

  • false -- Releasing LE Audio group failed.

返回:

The result of releasing LE Audio group.
